import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Define source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_66/test_0.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_66/test_1.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_66/test_2.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_66/test_3.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_66/test_4.csv"
    ]

    # List to hold dataframes
    dfs = []

    # Load each source CSV into a dataframe
    for file_path in source_files:
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path)
        # Ensure columns are exactly as target schema and in correct order
        # Target schema: ['Year', 'Category', 'Nominee', 'Movie', 'Winner']
        df = df[['Year', 'Category', 'Nominee', 'Movie', 'Winner']]
        dfs.append(df)

    # Concatenate all source dataframes into one
    target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # Convert all columns to string type as per target schema requirement
    for col in ['Year', 'Category', 'Nominee', 'Movie', 'Winner']:
        target_df[col] = target_df[col].astype(str)

    # Save the combined dataframe to the target path
    target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_66/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    target_df.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
